name: ciyex-rcm
description: Unlocks the full Revenue Cycle Management suite inside the Ciyex workbench: the Billing (RCM) sidebar, automated claim submission, ERA/EOB posting, denial work queues, secondary-payer coordination, patient statements and A/R reporting. Disable this extension to fall back to the built-in non-subscription 'lite' billing in the Payments editor.

ciyex.rcm.directUrl.description: Optional direct RCM service URL (e.g. http://localhost:8082) for local development. When blank, RCM calls go through the workbench app-proxy.
